response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack developer with genuine geospatial domain interest (GISCollective, FOSS4G talk) and some low-level/systems background (C/C++ at National Instruments, DLang high-performance async I/O work at Dunnhumby), but his current expertise centers on TypeScript/Node.js/web stacks rather than modern C++ or Rust, and he has no recent or deep experience with the routing/tiling, distributed-systems, or production navigation pipeline work this role demands.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective project and FOSS4G talk
Some C/C++ exposure (National Instruments) and high-performance async D work with fibers/caching at Dunnhumby
Strong generalist engineer with broad stack experience and demonstrated learning agility
concerns: No recent or substantial modern C++ or Rust experience for a role where it's the primary language
No direct experience with routing/navigation tile pipelines or real-time traffic data integration
Career has drifted toward web/product engineering (TypeScript/Node) rather than systems/distributed infrastructure work

key_factors.factor: Geospatial domain familiarity and systems background
